name: Default
shortDescription: Automated comic book (cbr/cbz) downloader that watches series, grabs new issues from NZB and torrent sources, then renames, sorts and metatags them.

alerts.message: The web UI is open to anyone with the URL until you set a username and password under Settings > Web Interface. Searching for series needs a free ComicVine API key (or the Comic Vine cache), and downloads need an NZB or torrent client or the built-in direct download, all configured in Settings.
